category_title: Students who sleep during the course and challenge teacher directives when woken
minimal_context: The student is expected to follow along with the teaching material on the board during active instructional time in the classroom.
dialogue:
TUTOR: Please look at the board and follow along with the teaching material for today's lesson.

STUDENT: (Looks directly at your face without any goals, showing interest in everything except the teaching material.)

TUTOR: Are you going to look at the material?

STUDENT: (Takes out a mobile phone and starts listening to music instead of following the lesson.)

TUTOR: Please put that away and focus on the lesson.

STUDENT: (Continues to ignore the teaching material, puts his head down on the table, and goes to sleep in the classroom.)

options.A: Provide the student with access to similar, but more socially appropriate, sensory stimulation, such as a squishy stress-relief ball.
options.B: Enhance the teacher's skills for drawing the student's attention toward the course, providing motivation, and assigning academic duties.
options.C: Stop using the threat of being 'seen as strange' by peers as a way to enforce behavior during instructional time.
options.D: Revise the Behavioral Intervention Plan (BIP) to include specific strategies for preventing escape attempts during the lesson.
